infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Sayzio can read your contacts so you can save someone you just met as a contact card from their Sayzio profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sayzio records the approximate location of NFC tag writes so you can see where each tag was provisioned. This is optional and only used while the app is open.
infoPlist.NFCReaderUsageDescription: Sayzio writes your short link to NFC tags so a tap opens your profile.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sayzio uses Face ID so you can unlock the app without re-entering your code.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sayzio records short voice clips when you tap the mic so the in-app assistant can transcribe what you said and reply by voice.
